sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release
facts: Release date is 5 June 2026 and links accredited environmental-account datasets.
The release includes atmospheric-emissions and energy-use datasets covering data through 2024.
Environmental-account measures retain their own accounting basis and are not parcel measurements.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin
facts: The bulletin estimates 478 million tonnes CO2e on a residence basis in 2024.
Residence-basis emissions include UK residents and UK-registered businesses wherever activity occurs.
Residence-basis figures must not be conflated with territorial or parcel-level estimates.

sources.title: ONS Environmental accounts topic page
facts: The topic page highlights the 2026 Environmental Accounts release.
It reports household and transport-industry shares within the environmental-account measure and energy-source shares.
Headline shares inherit the underlying environmental-account methodology and geography.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources — current
facts: The dataset covers renewable and waste energy use by source and industry from 1990 to 2024.
ONS documents scheduled revisions and corrections separately.
Energy-use activity data are not direct greenhouse-gas measurements for parcels.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type and industry — current
facts: The dataset covers fuel use by industry and fuel type from 1990 to 2024 and excludes biofuels and waste.
The page records both scheduled revisions and a correction to 2023 notation published in March 2026.
Fuel use must not be silently converted into parcel emissions.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: by industry, source and fuel — current
facts: The dataset disaggregates energy use by industry, activity source and fuel for 1990 to 2024.
Industry, source and fuel classifications must be preserved during reuse.
Activity data and measured greenhouse-gas emissions are distinct semantics.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type — current
facts: The dataset reports UK fuel use by fuel type from 1990 to 2024.
The table excludes biofuels and waste.
No unsupported conversion from national fuel use to parcel emissions is permitted.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: total — current
facts: The dataset covers direct and reallocated UK energy use by industry from 1990 to 2024.
It combines fossil and other energy sources under defined environmental-account classifications.
National energy-use totals do not establish individual parcel greenhouse-gas values.

sources.title: DfT Statistics at DfT
facts: The latest list includes SAF and RTFO 2025 fifth provisional releases dated 23 July 2026.
Vehicle licensing January to March 2026 is dated 15 July and Transport and environment 2024 is dated 14 July.
Publication chronology must be preserved rather than mixing releases from different dates.

sources.title: DfT Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection
facts: The collection lists the 2025 fifth provisional RTFO release on 23 July 2026.
Provisional figures are subject to change before the final report and should be treated as indicative.
Fuel-supply compliance statistics are not parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS monthly scheme update
facts: The page was updated 10 July 2026 with figures through 30 June 2026.
It reports applications, vouchers, redemptions, grants and scheme budget measures.
Scheme-administration counts and money values are not measured greenhouse-gas reductions.

sources.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme guidance for installers
facts: Version 5.1 is current for relevant applications from 28 April 2026.
Updated guidance applies to uplifted eligible off-gas-grid grant values from 21 July 2026.
Eligibility and grant guidance do not constitute emissions observations.

sources.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme guidance for property owners
facts: Version 5.1 is current for relevant applications from 28 April 2026.
The guidance notes uplifted eligible off-gas-grid grant values from 21 July 2026.
Application eligibility and voucher rules are scheme evidence rather than physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme Product Eligibility List
facts: The Product Eligibility List was updated 23 July 2026.
A listed product can still be ineligible for another reason and the list is not exhaustive.
Product eligibility does not prove parcel-level emissions or savings.

sources.title: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026
facts: The 2026 conversion factors were published 11 June 2026 for calculating and reporting emissions from UK activities.
The page distinguishes activity-based conversion factors from Defra spend-based multipliers.
Factors require appropriate activity data and are not direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: DESNZ Conversion factors 2026 Code statement
facts: The statement was published 11 June 2026.
It describes trustworthiness, quality and value expectations for the conversion-factor product.
Statistical quality assurance does not change factor-versus-measurement semantics.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools
facts: Country-specific carbon emission factors for annual emissions reporting 2026 were published 24 July 2026.
The factors are available for UK ETS monitoring and reporting in specified circumstances.
Compliance factors and reporting templates are not direct parcel physical-emissions observations.

sources.title: Taking part in UK ETS markets
facts: The market guidance was last updated 10 July 2026.
It covers auctions, secondary-market trading and cost-containment mechanisms.
Allowance prices and market volumes must not be treated as physical parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK ETS reports and scheme reviews
facts: The collection contains scheme or compliance data and reporting by the UK ETS Authority.
It separates market-functioning, allocation, emitter and registry public-report material.
Compliance and allocation records require facility-level interpretation and do not imply parcel measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS Registry public reports
facts: The Registry public-report page exposes account-holder and allocation reports including 2026 files.
The displayed reports are registry and allocation records.
Registry allocations and account holdings are not direct measurements of parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions 2005 to 2024
facts: The release was published 25 June 2026 and updated 30 June with accessible documents.
It provides local and regional greenhouse-gas estimates based on nationally available datasets.
Local-authority estimates are not individual parcel measurements and include stated allocation limitations.

sources.title: DESNZ 2005 to 2024 local and regional greenhouse gas statistical release — web accessible
facts: The accessible statistical release was updated 30 June 2026.
It documents 2024 emissions, trends, reconciliation, methodological improvements and revisions.
Local and regional reconciliation does not provide an automatic parcel-binding method.

sources.title: Defra UK and England carbon footprint to 2023 collection
facts: The collection was last updated 24 July 2026 and contains UK and England consumption-based footprint datasets.
The update history records corrections on 7 July and 24 July 2026.
Consumption-based footprint accounting must remain distinct from territorial and residence-basis statistics.

sources.title: Defra Carbon footprint for the UK and England to 2023
facts: The publication reports an estimated UK consumption footprint of 699 MtCO2e for 2023.
It records a 7 July 2026 correction to text concerning imports from the EU.
Consumption-based national estimates are not parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

guard_patterns.risk_prevented: scheme uptake treated as emissions outcome
future release treated as current data
